title: Beyond Fixed Luminance: Towards Panchromatic and Orthochromatic Image Colorization
abstract: arXiv:2608.10798v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most image colorization systems operate in $Lab$ space by predicting chroma ($ab$) while preserving an input-derived luminance channel ($L$). While effective on standard benchmarks, this fixed-luminance design restricts brightness changes and becomes unreliable when grayscale formation deviates from natural-image luminance, as in historical orthochromatic photography. We propose a luminance-agnostic colorization framework that formulates colorization as full-RGB image editing using a foundation image-editing model. To bridge modern panchromatic and historical orthochromatic conditions, we introduce a mixed grayscale objective that trains the model under both standard luminance grayscale and a red-insensitive grayscale formation. translated_title: 超越固定亮度：迈向全色与正色图像着色
translated_abstract: 大多数图像着色系统在$Lab$色彩空间中操作，通过预测色度（$ab$）同时保留输入导出的亮度通道（$L$）。尽管在标准基准上有效，但这种固定亮度设计限制了亮度变化，并在灰度形成偏离自然图像亮度时变得不可靠，例如在历史正色摄影中。我们提出了一种与亮度无关的着色框架，将着色问题表述为使用基础图像编辑模型的完整RGB图像编辑。为了弥合现代全色与历史正色条件之间的差距，我们引入了一种混合灰度目标，该目标在标准亮度灰度和红色不敏感灰度形成下训练模型。在COCO、ImageNet和多实例基准上的实验表明，我们的方法在标准灰度输入上具有竞争力，并且在正色输入下显著更鲁棒，定性结果也证实了其优越性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种亮度无关的着色框架，通过混合灰度目标训练基础图像编辑模型，在保持标准灰度性能的同时大幅提升历史正色摄影的着色鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a luminance-agnostic colorization framework that trains a foundation image-editing model with a mixed grayscale objective, achieving competitive performance on standard grayscale inputs while substantially improving robustness for historical orthochromatic photography.
